prompt:
Our engineering team has accumulated several months of daily work logs, a long-term memory document, and open issue trackers, all stored as markdown files in this workspace. We need to produce a single file called `knowledge_graph.json` that captures all the important people, projects, tools, events, and concepts from these logs — along with the relationships between them (like what depends on what, what caused what, and what enabled what).

The output needs to be structured so our dashboard can render it as an interactive graph. Please read the SKILL.md in this workspace to understand the exact schema and processing rules we follow, then process all the log files (`memory/`, `MEMORY.md`, `.issues/`) and generate the `knowledge_graph.json` file.
